title: User Embeddings are Superpositions of Interpretable Behavioral Modes
abstract: arXiv:2611.08487v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: User embeddings are central components of modern recommendation, personalization, and behavioral modeling systems. Though these embeddings can compactly encode rich behavioral information, they are inherently dense and opaque, limiting interpretability. To address this gap, we argue that user embeddings can be understood as sparse superpositions of interpretable behavioral modes. This structure is directly predicted by generative models of user behavior for linear embeddings and extends approximately to deep-learning representations by the superposition hypothesis. Superimposed modes can naturally be recovered by sparse dictionary learning methods, such as sparse autoencoders (SAEs), and recovered modes can be automatically named and queried in natural language. We validate mode recovery against known ground truth on synthetic data, where SAEs recover modes better than classical sparse baselines, including on transformer-encoded embeddin

translated_title: 用户嵌入是可解释行为模式的叠加
translated_abstract: 用户嵌入是现代推荐、个性化和行为建模系统的核心组件。尽管这些嵌入能够紧凑地编码丰富的行为信息，但它们本质上是稠密且不透明的，限制了可解释性。为解决这一空白，我们提出用户嵌入可以被理解为可解释行为模式的稀疏叠加。这一结构由用户行为的生成模型在线性嵌入情形下直接预测得出，并依据叠加假设可近似地扩展到深度学习表示。叠加的模式可以通过稀疏字典学习方法（如稀疏自编码器SAE）自然地恢复，且恢复出的模式可以被自动命名并支持自然语言查询。我们在合成数据上对照已知真值验证了模式恢复的效果，结果表明SAE在恢复模式方面优于经典的稀疏基线方法，包括在Transformer编码的嵌入上同样如此。
tldr: 该论文提出用户嵌入可被理解为可解释行为模式的稀疏叠加，并证明稀疏自编码器（SAE）能有效恢复这些行为模式，从而显著提升用户嵌入的可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes that user embeddings can be understood as sparse superpositions of interpretable behavioral modes, and demonstrates that sparse autoencoders (SAEs) can effectively recover these modes, significantly enhancing the interpretability of user embeddings.
